lines.en: Oh, you had said that you don't do anything personal during work time, so...
Oh, wait a minute. So you're gonna time me every time I yawn?
Oh, hey look. Monkey knows how to use a stopwatch, everybody.
There is no way that that was...
By any chance did you see Battlestar Galactica last night?
Actually not. It is really so-so.
I mean, I like all the crazy monsters and stuff. You know, like Klingons and Wookiees and...
Sorry, was there something you wanted to add to it?
Is that anything like the original Battlestar Galactica?
You know what's weird? It's practically a shot-for-shot remake.
The story's kind of bland. It's about this guy named Dumbledore Calrissian.
Who needs to return the ring back to Mordor.
He has not stopped working for a second.
At 12:45, he sneezed while keeping his eyes open, which I always thought was impossible.
At 1:32, he peed, and I know that because he did it in an open soda bottle under the desk while filling out expense reports.
And on the flip side, I've been so busy watching him that I haven't even started work.
I'll probably have to go home early today.
What were we doing for nineteen minutes and forty-eight seconds?
So, I guess I can assume that was...personal?
So, maybe you're not completely ethical after all.
